messages:
emi: Quick RFC follow-up — proposing a hybrid: keep a small verifiable token in the hot index and a thin chain of deltas in object storage for incremental updates. Aim: small KV values + auditability. Thoughts?

chris: I like hybrid. Token quick-check for serve, chain for full history. How small is the token?

taylor: Target ~64 bytes: model_hash, epoch, rollout_tag, expiry, flags, key_id + 8B truncated HMAC. Enough for the resolver to decide and avoid manifest fetch ~99% of time.

emi: Chain idea: deltas are content-addressed and small (pin, unpin, tag-update). Chain head goes into index alongside token: {"token":"...","chain":"ca:..."}. Resolvers prefer token, fall back to chain when token verification fails.

ops-lee: Ops: dual-write is required. Index becomes additive JSON to avoid breaking older clients. Migration playbook: dual-write -> canary region -> 2w metrics -> flip. Keep full manifests for audit.

sec-anya: Security: truncated HMAC ok if keys rotate and we monitor collision rates. For urgent retirements we need a push-based denylist to resolvers (in-memory). Also sign chain heads.

chris: Runtime: add a tiny cache token->expanded fields to reduce manifest pulls for traces/console. Also trace token_verif_fail and token_fallback_to_chain.

taylor: For partial rollouts, token only carries rollout_tag. Routing policy table keyed by rollout_tag holds weights/canary rules so we can change splits without repinning.

emi: Edge-case: key rotation during large rollout. Plan: embed key_id in token, resolvers fetch verification key by id with short TTL. If verification fails, fetch chain/manifest as fallback.

ops-lee: Metrics to gate: token.verify_fail_rate, token.fallback_rate, chain.replay_latency_p99. Target fallback_rate < 0.2% before flipping.

sec-anya: Add auditability: chain deltas include author, ts, prev_hash, change_type. Periodic snapshot to collapse long chains >= N deltas. Snapshots stored as content-addressed manifests.

bot-deploy: snapshot created: control-plane/rollout/hybrid-token-chain/1745553333

emi: Action items: taylor -> resolver PR to parse token + verify sig (1w), chris -> token->manifest cache & traces (5d), ops-lee -> migration playbook (3d), sec-anya -> signing/rotation note (3d). Sync Friday. :thumbsup:
